clips.text: Life is a sermon; existence preaches in its own way, but always indirectly - and that is the beauty of it.
The harmony in nature teaches, without any intention, the lesson of balance in life.
Look at a bird on the wing - and effortlessly you will go into meditation.
Or listen to its song - and for no reason your heart will move with it.
And when there is no effort on your part the meditation goes deep and suddenly transforms you; and when there is no motivation and you move - the movement is in the divine.
